logo.treatment: script wordmark in warm copper-brown, on white

platform.notes: A first pass misread this as WooCommerce because image URLs contain /wp-content/. The storefront is Next.js; WordPress is only the media/content backend.

display.usage: loaded site-wide but NOT used for product titles — see product_title below

product_title.verified_from: <h1 class="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold text-black mb-2 tracking-wide"> with NO playfair class, inheriting html{font-family:var(--font-lato)}
product_title.warning: Do not assume a luxury boutique uses a serif for product titles. This one does not. Rendering it as a serif was the single loudest tell in v1.

typography.root_note: Tailwind default, not overridden. Authoring a clone at 14px renders every chrome element ~13% small.

color.extraction_method: declared tokens in their compiled CSS, not sampled from a screenshot

layout.chrome_container_note: header and footer sit in a NARROWER container than the product grid — this is what makes their logo read as inset
layout.gallery: 2-column mosaic, images flow in order, cream placeholder background
layout.button_style: square corners, no radius; black fill for primary, white with black border for secondary; ~0.12em tracking, uppercase

navigation.breadcrumb_example: Home › Mens › Jackets, Blazers & Suits › Jackets › Beige Blue Silk Jacket | Men's

copy.subscribe_placeholder: Enter your email to get the latest promotions and news
copy.follow_line: Follow Us To Get The Latest Updates!
copy.copyright: Copyright © 2026 Barcelino Continental Corp. All rights reserved.
copy.voice: restrained, specification-forward, no exclamation marks; product copy leads with fabric and construction

catalog.photography: clean full-length model shots on white, plus fabric close-ups and editorial lifestyle frames

scraping.product_pages_via: plain curl — individual PDPs return full SSR HTML, costing ZERO firecrawl credits
scraping.title_tag_carries: name + price, e.g. "Beige Blue Silk Jacket | Men's - $1,675.00"
scraping.category_page_warning: Category listings hydrate client-side — product name/price are NOT in the category page HTML. Enumerate product URLs from links, then fetch each PDP.

provenance.viewport_warning: Always screenshot the clone at the SAME viewport as ground truth. Comparing 1440 against 1920 manufactures false width findings.
